description: Canonical state mapping and lifecycle taxonomy for active graph ingestion workflows.

RECEIVED.description: Source package received and intake directive opened; preliminary validation underway.

PREPARING.description: Extraction and candidate synthesis running in isolated staging sandbox.

READY_TO_AUTHORIZE.description: Extraction QA passed; proposed graph delta sealed and ready for authorization evaluation.

AWAITING_APPROVAL.description: No valid standing authority found; active approval request dispatched and awaiting human operator response.

AUTHORIZED.description: Authentic operator approval received or verified standing authority validated; proceeding to publication.

DECLINED.description: Operator explicitly declined candidate publication; workflow halted without graph mutation.

PUBLISHING.description: Writing approved candidate assertions and source nodes to staging knowledge graph.

RELEASE_PREPARED.description: Candidate release package staged; preparing for gate evaluation and activation.

EVALUATING.description: Running retrieval release qualification gates (E1-E3) and GraphDB integrity audits.

ACTION_AUTH_PENDING.description: Release gates passed; awaiting automated service action authorization (credentials/tokens).

ACTIVATING.description: Activating release generation via Universal Write Gateway and updating active pair pointer.

VERIFYING.description: Performing post-activation source coverage readback and table delta verification.

COMPLETE_UPDATED.description: Active ingestion completed successfully: source deltas published, generation advanced, and coverage verified.

COMPLETE_ALREADY_PRESENT.description: Source package already present in active graph with verified readback; zero net mutation.

BLOCKED.description: Ingestion halted by invariant violation, extraction QA failure, or missing prerequisites.

FAILED.description: Unrecoverable runtime error encountered during ingestion or activation.

CANCELLED.description: Ingestion run explicitly aborted by operator before publication.

RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.description: Generation drift, ambiguous identity merge, or concurrent lock conflict requires explicit reconciliation.
